reason: The cited substitution families and last-carrier inheritance do not nominate a complete two-argument case with a separately observable response at the second argument. The390 positions in382 cards are not eight established eligible scope cases. Broad and nearest scope need a response beyond the renderer assigning the same scope label.

design.contrast: Whole-sequence scope versus nearest-argument attachment, holding carrier type and envelope fixed.
design.countermodel: Renderer composition can repeat a local operator label across each carrier and mimic broad scope without a single scoped construction.
design.falsifier: Held cases with independently bound scope show the effect consistently stops at the nearest argument despite a second compatible value, or broad and nearest models make identical predictions in every case.
design.intake_limit: Raw proposal retained for later method review. Missing independently bound endpoints or identical model predictions are design/capacity stops, not empirical refutations. Source working glosses do not supply semantic gold.
design.mechanism: A constructional operator applies to all compatible argument values in its local sequence until a scope boundary, rather than selecting only the adjacent carrier.
design.prediction: If broad scope is encoded, adding a second compatible argument preserves the operator's effect on both values; nearest attachment affects only the adjacent value.
design.related: Near IDEA000038 ellipsis and GDT559 carrier grammar, but target is operator scope over multiple explicit arguments, not inherited-carrier reuse.
design.scope: GDT559 state cards; independent semantic scope endpoint availability_unknown.

source_evidence.quote:
Die vier bisherigen Einwortwerte bleiben kurz:

```text
Y     POSTEN
AIIN  WERT
AIN   ANTEIL
OR    EINHEIT
```

Neu ist nicht ein längeres Wörterbuch, sondern ihre gemeinsame Grammatik.
Unter den1,656 Zustandskarten tragen382 Karten insgesamt390 dieser
Argumentstellen. Alle fallen in nur sechs sichtbare `OT/OL/DY`-Hüllen und alle
erhalten eine kompositionelle Standardlesung.

| Hülle | Stellen | kurze Lesung |
|---|---:|---|
| `OT>A<END` | 185 | `DANACH · ARG` |
| `OL>A<END` | 156 | `FORTSETZEN · ARG` |
| `START>A<DY` | 31 | `ARG · ABSCHLIESSEN` |
| `START>A<OL` | 16 | `ARG · FORTSETZEN` |
| `OT>A<OL` | 1 | `DANACH · ARG · FORTSETZEN` |
| `OL>A<OL` | 1 | `FORTSETZEN · ARG · FORTSETZEN` |
